verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk operation, such as multi-select delete, move, tag, share or export across many conversations. Cross-meeting AI analysis via MCP and search across all transcripts are read-only, adjacent features, not bulk actions on items. The read-only Public API and per-meeting automatic exports (S3, Airtable) are at most developer building blocks or per-item automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
